research.title: Organization and Date Extraction from Reviews

bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public product review records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.

Under supervision, used regular-expression and dictionary rules with Python re to extract organization and date spans from public product reviews, then compared extracted spans with provided manually checked examples.
Cleaned supplied product review metadata tables using pandas and provided steps; plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
